"In the ChatGPT sandbox, you cannot run a real, reachable \u201cweb proxy\u201d in the normal sense (an always-on endpoint that your browser/app can send requests to). The sandbox has these hard constraints:\n\nNo inbound networking (nothing outside can call a server you start in the sandbox).\n\nNo persistent daemon across turns (anything you start is not a durable service).\n\nNo stable public URL exposed from the sandbox.\n\nSo the answer to \u201cwhat can actually be used as a web proxy for MetaBlooms in the ChatGP"
